brand.name: Mumzo
brand.vibe: Warm, playful, soft pastels, nurturing, premium, craft-driven

typography.guidelines: Headings must use Fraunces with tight tracking (tracking-tighter) to feel editorial. Body copy in Manrope for clean legibility. Add 'Caveat' for hand-drawn, playful accent notes.

visual_enhancers.border_radius: Extensive use of rounded corners. Buttons and tags should be pill-shaped (rounded-full). Product frames should use rounded-3xl or arched clipping.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Warm, ambient, diffuse shadows. Example: shadow-[0_12px_40px_rgb(31,27,58,0.08)]
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a global fixed SVG grain/noise overlay (opacity-40, pointer-events-none, mix-blend-multiply) to give a tactile, printed feel.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Clipped frames (pill shapes, arches) for all product photography to break the standard rectangle.

layouts.navigation: Sticky, glassmorphic header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFBF7]/80). Logo left, minimal links, pill-shaped primary CTA right. Z-index 50.
layouts.hero: Min-h-[90vh] center-aligned layout. Dominated by oversized Fraunces typography. Line-by-line reveal. Floating clipped images drifting in space via framer-motion parallax.
layouts.marquee: Full-width editorial ribbon. Pale sage background, massive Fraunces text separated by middle dots, moving slowly.
layouts.manifesto_chapters: Asymmetric bento grid or staggering left-right sections. Numbered 01, 02, 03 using massive (text-[12vw]) pale absolute-positioned numerals behind the text.
layouts.product_showcase: Curated grid of spotlight product photos (clothes, toys, food) in clipped frames. High-quality imagery, breathing room (p-12).
layouts.hyderabad_banner: High-impact block, likely using the peach accent background. Emphasizing 'Launching in Hyderabad initially'.
layouts.waitlist_form: Centered, narrow container (max-w-md). Inputs must have pill-shape borders and soft focus states. Fields: Name, Email, Address, Baby's Name, Baby's Age.

motion.scroll_engine: Must install and configure @studio-freight/react-lenis for premium momentum scrolling.
motion.hero_reveal: Framer Motion: Wrap text lines in overflow-hidden divs. Animate the text spans inside from {y: '100%'} to {y: '0%'} with a smooth ease (e.g., [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]).
motion.scroll_reveals: Sections use whileInView animations (opacity 0 -> 1, y 30 -> 0) to glide into place.
motion.parallax: Use useScroll and useTransform for floating elements in the hero and chapter numbers moving at different speeds than the scroll.

hero_mom_baby.description: Mom carrying baby smiling, warm edit

components.name: KineticHero
components.instructions: Build a large H1 with text 'The deepest depth of SKUs. Delivered with love.' Mask each line using framer-motion. Include drifting floating images (use hero_mom_baby and product_clothes) in clipped arch/pill shapes.

components.name: EditorialMarquee
components.instructions: Use react-fast-marquee. Text: 'Delivered with love · to your doorstep · in Hyderabad · 10 minute delivery ·'. Large italic/serif font, Sage background.

components.name: ManifestoChapters
components.instructions: Create 3 chapters (01. The Problem, 02. The Solution, 03. The Promise). Alternate layouts (image left/text right). Use massive typography for the numbers and place them in the background. Use the Caveat font for a small hand-drawn note in one of the chapters.

components.name: WaitlistForm
components.instructions: Fields: name, email, address, baby_name, baby_age. Use native HTML + Tailwind for standard text inputs, but style them beautifully with rounded-full, border-border, and focus:ring-primary. Include a submit button that says 'Join the Waitlist' with a subtle hover scale.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the navy text (#1F1B3A) passes WCAG AA against #FDFBF7, #FDE2CE, and #D8E2D5.
accessibility.aria: Add aria-labels to the marquee and any purely decorative images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs) must include data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST read this JSON and apply its instructions precisely.
Theme: DO NOT default to a dark mode or standard tech aesthetic. This is a warm, pastel, premium maternal brand. Stick strictly to the colors provided.
Typography: Import Fraunces, Manrope, and Caveat from Google Fonts in index.css. Apply Fraunces to all h1-h6 tags.
Layouts: Avoid Shadcn Card components for the main layout. Build custom asymmetrical sections and grids using Tailwind HTML.
Motion: Install and implement @studio-freight/react-lenis at the root App level. Install framer-motion and use it for all scroll reveals and the kinetic hero.
Hero: The line-by-line reveal is critical for the 'Awwwards' feel. Wrap text in overflow-hidden, animate inner spans.
Textures: Inject an SVG noise/grain overlay spanning the entire viewport to kill the 'digital flatness'.
DO NOT apply transition: all globally. Use specific transition-colors or transition-transform.
Do not use default icons unless necessary; rely heavily on the typography and provided Unsplash imagery.
